# IT Support FAQ

## How do I reset my password?
Click "Forgot Password" on the login page and enter your work email address.
A password reset link is sent to that address. The reset link is valid for 30 minutes.
After opening the link, choose a new password of at least 12 characters and log in again.

## My account is locked after failed login attempts
Accounts are locked for 15 minutes after five failed login attempts.
Wait 15 minutes and try again, or use "Forgot Password" to set a new password immediately.

## How do I connect to the VPN?
Install the company VPN client from the Software Center, open it and sign in with your work account.
Approve the sign-in request in the authenticator app to complete the connection.

## How do I request new software?
Submit a software request through the IT self-service portal. Requests are reviewed by your
manager and usually completed within two working days.

## When is my laptop replaced?
Laptops are refreshed every three years by the IT asset team. You will receive an email when
your replacement device is ready for collection.
